21: /**
22:  * M3-A01/M3-A02 multipart 严格解析（DD 3.3/10.1；contracts M3A01Metadata/
23:  * M3A02Metadata）：metadata part（application/json，未知字段拒绝）+ 二进制
24:  * 图片 part。缺 part / 多 part / 非法字段一律 400 INVALID_INPUT；三图合计超
25:  * 限 413 UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE。
26:  */
27: @Component
28: public class AssessmentMultipartParser {
29: 
30:     private static final Pattern BIGINT = Pattern.compile("^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$");
31:     private static final Set<String> VIEWS = Set.of("front", "left", "right");
32: 
33:     private final ObjectMapper mapper;
34:     private final long maxRequestBytes;
35: 
36:     public AssessmentMultipartParser(ObjectMapper mapper,
37:                                      @Value("${app.assessments.max-request-bytes:33554432}")
38:                                      long maxRequestBytes) {
39:         this.mapper = mapper;
40:         this.maxRequestBytes = maxRequestBytes;
41:     }
42: 
43:     public record A01Metadata(String photoVersion, String captureSessionId, String consentEvidenceRef) {
44:     }
45: 
46:     public record A02Metadata(String expectedPhotoVersion, List<String> replacedViews) {
47:     }
48: 
49:     public record ParsedA01(A01Metadata metadata, Map<String, byte[]> images) {
50:     }
51: 
52:     public record ParsedA02(A02Metadata metadata, Map<String, byte[]> images) {
53:     }
54: 
55:     public ParsedA01 parseA01(HttpServletRequest request) {
56:         RawParts raw = split(request);
57:         A01Metadata md = readMetadata(raw.metadataBytes(), A01Metadata.class);
58:         if (!BIGINT.matcher(nullToEmpty(md.photoVersion())).matches() || !"1".equals(md.photoVersion())) {
59:             throw invalid("photoVersion must be the bigint string \"1\" for a new task");
60:         }
61:         requireText(md.captureSessionId(), "captureSessionId", 128);
62:         requireText(md.consentEvidenceRef(), "consentEvidenceRef", 128);
63:         Map<String, byte[]> images = requireExactViews(raw.imageParts(), VIEWS, "front,left,right");
64:         checkTotalSize(images);
65:         return new ParsedA01(md, images);
66:     }
67: 
68:     public ParsedA02 parseA02(HttpServletRequest request) {
69:         RawParts raw = split(request);
70:         A02Metadata md = readMetadata(raw.metadataBytes(), A02Metadata.class);
71:         if (md.expectedPhotoVersion() == null || !BIGINT.matcher(md.expectedPhotoVersion()).matches()) {
72:             throw invalid("expectedPhotoVersion must be a decimal bigint string");
73:         }
74:         List<String> replaced = md.replacedViews();
75:         if (replaced == null || replaced.isEmpty()) {
76:             throw invalid("replacedViews must be a non-empty list");
77:         }
78:         LinkedHashSet<String> requested = new LinkedHashSet<>();
79:         for (String view : replaced) {
80:             if (!VIEWS.contains(view)) {
81:                 throw invalid("replacedViews entries must be one of front,left,right");
82:             }
83:             requested.add(view);
84:         }
85:         if (requested.size() != replaced.size()) {
86:             throw invalid("replacedViews must be unique");
87:         }
88:         Map<String, byte[]> images = requireExactViews(raw.imageParts(), requested,
89:                 String.join(",", requested));
90:         checkTotalSize(images);
91:         return new ParsedA02(md, images);
92:     }
93: 
94:     private record RawParts(byte[] metadataBytes, Map<String, byte[]> imageParts) {
95:     }
96: 
97:     private RawParts split(HttpServletRequest request) {
98:         if (!(request instanceof MultipartHttpServletRequest multi)) {
99:             throw invalid("multipart/form-data request required");
100:         }
101:         Map<String, byte[]> parts = new LinkedHashMap<>();
102:         for (Map.Entry<String, MultipartFile> e : multi.getFileMap().entrySet()) {
103:             try {
104:                 parts.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue().getBytes());
105:             } catch (Exception ex) {
106:                 throw invalid("unreadable multipart part: " + e.getKey());
107:             }
108:         }
109:         byte[] metadata = parts.remove("metadata");
110:         if (metadata == null && multi.getParameter("metadata") != null) {
111:             metadata = multi.getParameter("metadata").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
112:         }
113:         if (metadata == null) {
114:             throw invalid("metadata part is required");
115:         }
116:         // 未声明的额外 multipart 文本参数同样拒绝（防未知字段静默成功）
117:         for (String name : multi.getParameterMap().keySet()) {
118:             if (!"metadata".equals(name)) {
119:                 throw invalid("unknown multipart field: " + name);
120:             }
121:         }
122:         return new RawParts(metadata, parts);
123:     }
124: 
125:     private Map<String, byte[]> requireExactViews(Map<String, byte[]> parts, Set<String> expected,
126:                                                   String label) {
127:         if (!parts.keySet().equals(expected)) {
128:             List<String> missing = new ArrayList<>(expected);
129:             missing.removeAll(parts.keySet());
130:             List<String> extra = new ArrayList<>(parts.keySet());
131:             extra.removeAll(expected);
132:             throw invalid("image parts must be exactly [" + label + "]; missing=" + missing
133:                     + " extra=" + extra);
134:         }
135:         return parts;
136:     }
137: 
138:     private void checkTotalSize(Map<String, byte[]> images) {
139:         long total = 0;
140:         for (byte[] b : images.values()) {
141:             total += b.length;
142:             if (total > maxRequestBytes) {
143:                 throw new ApiException(ErrorCode.UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE,
144:                         "total image bytes exceed configured limit " + maxRequestBytes);
145:             }
146:         }
147:     }
148: 
149:     private <T> T readMetadata(byte[] bytes, Class<T> type) {
150:         try {
151:             return mapper.readValue(bytes, type);
152:         } catch (ApiException e) {
153:             throw e;
154:         } catch (Exception e) {
155:             throw invalid("metadata is not a valid " + type.getSimpleName());
156:         }
157:     }
158: 
159:     private static void requireText(String value, String field, int max) {
160:         if (value == null || value.isEmpty()) {
161:             throw invalid(field + " is required");
162:         }
163:         if (value.length() > max) {
164:             throw invalid(field + " exceeds max length " + max);
165:         }
166:     }
167: 
168:     private static String nullToEmpty(String v) {
169:         return v == null ? "" : v;
170:     }
171: 
172:     private static ApiException invalid(String message) {
173:         return new ApiException(ErrorCode.INVALID_INPUT, message);
174:     }
175: }

final class GimbalAiSseParser {
    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();
    private static final Set<String> EVENTS = Set.of("response.accepted","delta","completed","failed");
    private static final int MAX_EVENTS = 10_000;
    private static final int MAX_ANSWER_CHARS = 200_000;

    static String parse(String body) {
        if (body == null || body.isBlank()) throw malformed("empty stream body");
        String[] lines = body.split("\r\n|\n|\r", -1);
        String eventName = null;
        StringBuilder data = new StringBuilder();
        boolean hasData = false;
        boolean terminalSeen = false;
        boolean completedSeen = false;
        String answer = null;
        StringBuilder deltas = new StringBuilder();
        int eventCount = 0;

        for (String line : lines) {
            if (line.isEmpty()) {
                // dispatch
                if (eventName != null || hasData) {
                    eventCount++;
                    if (eventCount > MAX_EVENTS) throw malformed("too many SSE events");
                    boolean terminal = dispatch(eventName, hasData ? data.toString() : null, ...);
                    ...
                }
                reset
            } else if (line.startsWith(":")) {
                continue;
            } else {
                int colon = line.indexOf(':');
                String field = colon < 0 ? line : line.substring(0, colon);
                String value = colon < 0 ? "" : line.substring(colon+1);
                if (value.startsWith(" ")) value = value.substring(1);
                switch(field) {
                    case "event" -> eventName = value;
                    case "data" -> { if (hasData) data.append('\n'); data.append(value); hasData = true; }
                    default -> { /* ignore id/retry/unknown fields per SSE */ }
                }
            }
        }
        // EOF dispatch pending block
        ...
        if (!completedSeen) throw malformed("stream ended without a completed terminal event");
        return answer;
    }
}

private static void dispatch(String event, String data, State state, StringBuilder deltas) {
    if (event == null) {
        // data with no event name → malformed (SSE default event type is "message", which is unknown)
        throw malformed("SSE data without event name");
    }
    if (!EVENTS.contains(event)) {
        throw malformed("unknown SSE event: " + event);
    }
    if (state.terminal) {
        // any event after terminal (including duplicate terminal)
        throw malformed("SSE event after terminal: " + event);
    }
    if (data == null) {
        throw malformed("SSE event missing data: " + event);
    }
    JsonNode root;
    try { root = MAPPER.readTree(data); } catch (Exception e) { throw malformed("SSE data is not valid JSON"); }
    if (root == null || !root.isObject()) throw malformed("SSE data is not a JSON object");
    switch (event) {
        case "response.accepted" -> { /* informational */ }
        case "delta" -> {
            JsonNode delta = root.get("delta");
            if (delta == null || !delta.isTextual()) throw malformed("delta event missing textual 'delta'");
            deltas.append(delta.asText());
            if (deltas.length() > MAX_ANSWER_CHARS) throw malformed("accumulated delta exceeds bound");
        }
        case "completed" -> {
            JsonNode text = root.path("answer").path("text");
            if (!text.isTextual() || text.asText().isBlank()) throw malformed("completed event missing non-blank answer.text");
            state.answer = text.asText();
            state.terminal = true;
        }
        case "failed" -> {
            String code = root.path("code").isTextual() ? root.path("code").asText() : null;
            throw new GimbalAiException(GimbalAiFailureKind.UNAVAILABLE,
                    "gimbal AI downstream reported a failed stream", null, code);
        }
    }
}
```

private volatile long frameDelayMillis = 0;
private volatile CountDownLatch heldGate = null;
private volatile String heldFrame = null;

void script(List<String> frames, long frameDelayMillis) { this.scriptFrames = frames; this.frameDelayMillis = ...; this.heldGate=null; this.heldFrame=null; }
void scriptHeld(List<String> preFrames, String heldFrame) { this.scriptFrames = preFrames; this.heldFrame = heldFrame; this.heldGate = new CountDownLatch(1); this.frameDelayMillis = 0; }

void releaseHeld() { if (heldGate != null) heldGate.countDown(); }

final class TimeoutLineSource implements AutoCloseable {
    private final BlockingQueue<Object> queue = new LinkedBlockingQueue<>();
    private static final Object EOF = new Object();
    private final Thread worker;
    TimeoutLineSource(BufferedReader reader, long timeoutMillis) { ... worker reads lines, puts; on EOF puts EOF; on IOException puts an IOException; }
    /** @return line, or null at EOF; throws GimbalAiException TIMEOUT/UNAVAILABLE */
    String readLine() {
        Object item = queue.poll(timeoutMillis, MILLISECONDS);
        if (item == null) { close(); throw timeout; }
        if (item == EOF) return null;
        if (item instanceof IOException io) { throw unavailable(io); }
        return (String) item;
    }
    close() { reader.close(); worker.interrupt(); }
}
```

private static final class TimeoutLineSource implements GimbalAiLineSource {
    private final BlockingQueue<Object> queue = new LinkedBlockingQueue<>();
    private static final Object EOF = new Object();
    private final BufferedReader reader;
    private final long timeoutMillis;
    private final Thread worker;

    TimeoutLineSource(InputStream in, long timeoutMillis) {
        this.reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(in, UTF_8));
        this.timeoutMillis = timeoutMillis;
        this.worker = new Thread(this::pump, "gimbal-ai-sse-reader");
        this.worker.setDaemon(true);
        this.worker.start();
    }
    private void pump() {
        try {
            String line;
            while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
                queue.put(line);
            }
            queue.put(EOF);
        } catch (IOException io) {
            queue.offer(io);  // offer in case interrupted
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
        }
    }
    @Override public String readLine() {
        try {
            Object item = queue.poll(timeoutMillis, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
            if (item == null) {
                close();
                throw new GimbalAiException(TIMEOUT, "gimbal AI downstream stream read timed out");
            }
            if (item == EOF) return null;
            if (item instanceof IOException io) {
                throw new GimbalAiException(UNAVAILABLE, "gimbal AI downstream stream failed");
            }
            return (String) item;
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            throw new GimbalAiException(UNAVAILABLE, "gimbal AI downstream read interrupted");
        }
    }
    @Override public void close() {
        try { reader.close(); } catch (IOException ignored) {}
        worker.interrupt();
    }
}

- `gimbalai/GimbalAiProperties.java`: `app.gimbal-ai.*` config with safe empty defaults, timeout normalization, keyed-only missing errors, redacting `toString`.

- `docs/catalog/GimbalAiDocs.java`: Swagger/OpenAPI catalog entry with SSE success shape and the stateless/no-continuation_state limitation.
- `resources/application.yml`: `app.gimbal-ai.{base-url,api-key,connect-timeout-millis,read-timeout-millis}` env placeholders, default empty.
